body_markdown:
DineSafe is excited to participate in and present at the 13th Poultry Federation Annual Food Safety Conference on March 4-6, 2025, in Hot Springs, Arkansas. We will have the opportunity to discuss the innovative use of consumer crowdsourcing for monitoring real-time food safety trends. This conference is a space for industry representatives, food safety professionals, and the academic community to discuss and discover critical information on food safety, quality, and compliance challenges.


The Poultry Federation (TPF) is a multi-state trade organization representing the poultry and egg industry in Arkansas, Missouri, and Oklahoma. TPF promotes and protects the interests of the industry and is a unified voice before the state governments. The 13th edition of the[Food Safety Conference](https://app.glueup.com/event/2025-food-safety-conference-122847/home.html) , hosted annually by TPF, features some of the best and most knowledgeable speakers in the business. This growing event gathers participants from all around the country, making it a key gathering for industry professionals.


Our presentation " *Monitoring Social Media for Food Safety* " will explore the role of social media monitoring in identifying potential food safety concerns. We aim to share how we can leverage these tools and strategies for effectively mitigating risks. By integrating social media monitoring into their food safety protocols, businesses can stay ahead of issues, protect consumers, and maintain trust in their brands.


We are grateful for the invitation to contribute to the discussion on this key topic for the industry and look forward to collaborating with fellow experts.


For additional information about our upcoming and previous presentations, please visit our events page[here](https://dinesafe.com/events/) .
